summary: # CLO7.3 New Features: AI-generated Textures, Quick Editing of Multiple Panels... A Comprehensive Update to Enhance Your Design Experience! Hello everyone, I am Claude Andy. Today, Celia and I will explain the new features of version 7.3 for you. The new features mainly include six parts: the main functions, UI interface, 2D enhancements, virtual models, materials, and the model and editor. Let me explain the first three parts. ## Main Function ### Fabric Generator In the new version of CLO 7.3, the main function to be mentioned is the fabric generator. We can easily generate fabric based on the input actual fabric information. We can also use the preview window to see the model results. #### How to Use the Fabric Generator We can open the fabric generator in two ways: 1. Select the material in the main menu. 2. Select the editor and then select the fabric generator. The fabric generator will appear in the preview window at the same time as the new default material is added to the preview window. The other way to open it is to right-click on the existing fabric in the preview window and select the fabric generator. If you want to apply it to the clothing when creating the fabric, or you want to use the fabric generator to recreate the fabric already applied to the clothing, you can use it. ### Fabric Generator Window Interface The window interface of the fabric generator is mainly divided into two sections: 1. The lower window allows you to enter the fabric information you want to generate, selecting the type of fabric, ingredients, and the percentage of input ingredients. You can also enter the weight and set the texture of the fabric to be generated. 2. In the preview window above, you can open the results in 3D according to the input information. In the default situation, the preview window can be opened. You can select the size and shape of the fabric, and you can change the preview window to the desired view by selecting the preview window in the upper right corner. You can also use the mouse to move the screen to define the view. After adjusting the view, you can click the lock icon in the upper right corner to fix the view you have adjusted. #### Model Selection In the model selection in the upper left corner, you can select the round shape, flat shape, and square shape. The current state is that the diameter is 30 cm, and the round shape is placed on the round shape. Through this pull list, we can select the flat shape. We can see that the fabric is flat on the human model as a flat shape. The square round shape can be seen as a shape of a 30 cm x 30 cm square object covered on the round shape. ### Using the Fabric Generator Next, we will operate on how to use the fabric generator. First, fill in the information of the fabric: enter the name of the fabric, the supplier, and all users, then select the fabric type and ingredients to be generated. The fabric type here provides 63 types of fabric, and you can select the fabric type according to your needs. The ingredient options for different fabric types will also change. Therefore, we will select the fabric type and the corresponding ingredients at a time, and enter the percentage of the ingredients and the weight. You can edit the model result in the show window based on the input. ### Setting Up Fabric Structure There are three ways to set up the fabric structure in the fabric generator: 1. If we have the suitable tire structure, we can manually add patterns to define the fabric material we need to improve its performance. 2. If you don't have a suitable sticker, you can use the Closed preview texture. Open the Closed preview texture to see the texture options that match the selected material type. Then select and download the texture you want. After downloading, click on it to apply it to the material. 3. The last method: on the right side of the texture sticker, there is a model icon. Click it to open the window of the AI texture generator. You can use it to generate and apply the texture. The detailed operation method of the AI texture generator will be discussed later. After setting up the material type and texture, if you need to make detailed adjustments to the physical properties of the material, click on the details option on the left side of the small handle. ### Physical Properties of Materials Before the new version of CLO 7.3, it used 16 parameters to represent the physical properties of the plant. However, in the material generator, we will use the same method. We added 4 parameters called growth rate on the original parameter base, bringing the total number to 20. The physical properties of the closed material are now divided into V1 and V2. V1 is the data measured by the current material measurement, while V2 is the material data created by our material generator. In V2, with the improvement of the non-linear stretching implementation method, it allows the use of linear variables for more detailed control. ### Material Generation and Application After the material is generated, click the English button below. In the material generator, the input information will be updated in the material attribute editor. At the same time, this material will be applied to 3D clothing. All you need to do is click the model key in the 3D window to check the condition of the clothing. Please remember that the result displayed in the 3D window is based on the data generated by the test穿. In order to accurately reflect the physical properties of the material, the test穿 model must be used. When you click the application and close, the attribute of the material will be applied to the clothing, and the material generator window will be closed at the same time. To store the raw material in the ZFAB format, click the save button in the lower left corner. If you just want to adjust the physical properties of the material, you can click the details in the physical properties menu of the attribute editor. Click the arrow button in the upper right corner. Click the material generator details window to adjust the value. ### Versioning of Materials As mentioned above, the material generator increases and uses a new parameter, Hers swallow rate, as the original parameter-class material stored in the previous version, 7.3. It has been marked as V1, including the volume of the new parameter who fulfillme journal. Select the material and then in the information in the attribute editor, the physical attribute is difficult to check. If the material is version 1, it will be displayed as V1. Version 2 is displayed as V2. For more detailed information, you can click the triangle icon on the left. Then the output is divided into the creator and the data state. In the creator menu, you can check the creation method of the material, whether it is default material, the material calculation, or the material generated by the material generator. In the data state column, you can check whether the physical properties of the material have been changed. If the detailed information has not been changed, it is original. If you change it, it will be edited. ### Material Types in CLO 7.3 The material generator can use three types of materials in CLO 7.3 or higher versions: 1. The material created by the increase button on the roof window. 2. The second is in the material generator, using V2.3, all materials necessary for the production of the material. 3. The third is to convert from V1 to V2. #### How to Convert V1 to V2 The materials stored in the version before CLO 7.3 can't use them in the material generator because of the lack of related data. One of the increase rates introduced in V2. So open it with the material generator. A friends window that will not be able to be read in the material generator will appear. For the materials produced in the version before 7.3, if there is data that uses the same measurement as the same measurement, it can be converted to V2. When there is measurement data in the ZFAB, the physical attribute will be displayed as the measurement calculation. To convert V1 to V2, first select V1 in the physical window. In the physical editor, the physical attribute on the right side will see a conversion icon. If the material does not have the measurement data, it will not display the conversion icon. Click on Convert. You will notice that the physical attribute in the attribute editor will change from V1 to V2. If you want to check the material simulation effect stored in the CLO 7.3 version, you want to use the material generator to predict rather than simulate, or you want to add growth rate parameters to the material and make detailed adjustments, you need to convert V1 to V2. The original material in CLO 7.3 can be converted to V2 and then used in the material generator because they have the measurement data. In addition, in order to make it easier for users to use V2 material and the material generator to perform various tasks, the material preset has also been updated. You can see that about 190 V2 materials have been added to CLO 7.3. ### AI Physics Generator The second main function to be introduced is the AI physics generator. By setting and inputting keywords, the physics of the generated material with the required pattern is displayed. In addition, you can also check the generated pattern on 3D clothing.
